Test Case 6: Pod Status Validation

Input: kubectl get pods -n metabob

Expected Output:
- At least 4 pods deployed (config, redis, rpc-api, dashboard)
- All pods reach Running status
- Pod names match expected patterns:
  - config-*
  - redis-master-0
  - metabob-rpc-api-worker-*
  - metabob-rpc-api-service-*
  - metabob-dashboard-*

Validation:
- Verifies all required services are deployed
- Confirms pods are healthy and running
- Tests resource allocation (pods should be schedulable with 512Mi memory)
- Validates statefulsets (redis) and deployments are working

Note: May take 2-5 minutes for all pods to reach Running status.
